---
name: Bug report
about: Something in the course is wrong or broken
title: "[bug] "
labels: bug
---

**What's wrong?** (a wrong number, a broken link, a code snippet that doesn't run)

**Where?** (file path + section/line)

**What did you expect / what happened instead?**

**If it's lab code: paste the error** (traceback, versions — `pip freeze | grep <pkg>`)

**Environment (for lab issues):** OS / Python version / local or API model

---

*Numbers that can go stale (prices, model specs, dataset sizes) are date-stamped in the text — if a number looks old, say so; date-rot fixes are the most welcome PRs of all.*
